This mod allows you to create beautiful aquariums and manage your own aquatic ecosystem.
The Fish Tank is the core of this mod. It can hold water, lava, decorations, and fish. U can use a bucket, or pipes from other mods to fill it.
The Fish Bag allows you to transport fish safely. Right-click a fish to catch it, and shift-right-click to release it.
The Aquarist Table is used to craft decorations and fish food. It's essential for maintaining a healthy tank.
Configuration options are only available in Creative Mode.
Fish in tanks will occasionally lay eggs if they are well-fed. These eggs can be used for trading or cracked in the Aquarist's Table to obtain resources.
Fish need food to survive and reproduce. You can craft various types of food like Flakes and Pellets at the Aquarist Table.
Obtainable from the Aquarist Villager. Contains a surprise fish! Shift-right-click to open and reveal your new aquatic friend.
Decorations can be crafted at the Aquarist Table. They make your tank look great and provide shelter for your fish.
